title: DeepSeek-R1 joins the text models
summary:
DeepSeek-R1 joined the model lineup, while community projects got their listings back and a simpler way to submit new ones.

Added `deepseek-r1`, a reasoning-enabled DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B chat model. `llamalight` now uses Llama 3.1 8B, and the text API’s 60-request per-IP queue cap was removed.

The Projects page now has a Submit Your Project button that opens a GitHub issue form, replacing email submissions. The form asks how a project uses Pollinations and what it was built with.

Project listings lost in the previous UI update were restored and organized by type, from LLM integrations to tutorials. The site and README also got updated image-generation figures and a clearer description of Pollinations’ open-source roots and Berlin location.
